* use web.game/update-and-send-diffs! for all test actions by @NoahTheDuke in https://github.com/mtgred/netrunner/pull/8852
* fix: default sound to 50% by @filipesilva in https://github.com/mtgred/netrunner/pull/8851
* clean up merge-costs, some other small wins by @NoahTheDuke in https://github.com/mtgred/netrunner/pull/8855
* Clean up logging by @NoahTheDuke in https://github.com/mtgred/netrunner/pull/8844
